summary: Describes how the IESG handles documents submitted for RFC publication through the RFC Editor, following changes proposed at the March 2004 Seoul IETF meeting. It updates procedures from RFC 2026 and RFC 3710. It is a Best Current Practice, and was replaced by RFC 5742.

eli5.summary: It is the rulebook for how the IETF's reviewers look at writings that come in through a side door instead of a working group. A later rulebook replaced it.

questions: how are rfc editor documents reviewed by the iesg
